Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Dust Line Update Is Out Today, Patch Notes
Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Dust Line Update Is Out Today, Patch Notes
Tons of fixes and needed rebalances. The new operators seem a bit OP at the moment, but I don't know if that will last. It'll be interesting to see how they change the metagame.

I'm impressed with how much attention went into addressing players' pet peeves with specific operators.

  • Tachanka's turrets will be easier to place and have a faster mount/dismount
  • Rook can now shoot his own armor bag without penalty in order to keep extra vests from the enemy team
  • Thatcher's emps have been scaled back so that they don't hit an entire room
  • I.Q.'s scanner visibility is improved
  • Sledge now has flash grenades instead of breaching charges since his hammer does that already

and the things that they "nerfed" make a lot of sense when you get right down to it:

  • Frost gets barbed wire instead of C4 - more in line with her trapping theme and gives her an additional way to hide welcome mats
  • Thermite gets flash bangs instead of frags - more in line with his surprise and misdirect abilities
  • Buck gets frags - more in line with his wall-breaching small holes and attacking through them

I agree that the new operators may end up being overpowered, but I'm sure they'll find their footing as well. The development team has shown consistent attention to player concerns so far, so I expect good work from them moving forward as well.

Honestly Rainbow Six: Siege is probably my favorite game of 2016. Co-op, solo, or versus.
